---
# HOW TO ADD A PROJECT
# 1. Copy this file in the projects folder with a short name, e.g. projects/vaccine-research.qmd
#    (the file name becomes the project's tag; files starting with "_" are ignored).
# 2. Fill in the fields below, then the sections of the page.
# 3. To link content to the project automatically, list words in match > keywords.
#    Any paper, Substack post or video whose title, description or tags contain
#    one of these words will appear under "Outputs so far".
#    For hand-added items (data/outputs.yml, data/linkedin.yml, dashboards),
#    add a line:  projects: ["vaccine-research"]
title: "Project title"
description: "One sentence on what the project does."
order: 9                # position on the Projects page
stage: 1                # 1 Idea, 2 Design, 3 Data, 4 Analysis, 5 Writing, 6 Shared (0 = programme)
stage_note: "What is happening right now, in a few words"
updated: "2026-11-01"
match:
  keywords: ["word one", "word two"]
  links: []             # exact links or DOIs that always belong to this project
listing:
  id: proj-outputs
  contents: [../data/publications.yml, ../data/outputs.yml, ../data/substack.yml, ../data/youtube.yml, ../data/linkedin.yml, ../dashboards/*.qmd, "!../dashboards/_template.qmd"]
  include: { projects: "project-file-name" }
  template: ../styles/list-mixed.ejs
  sort: "date desc"
  date-format: "MMM YYYY"
---
